findings.location: Source HTML, paragraph beginning «How sad it is…»; quoted 1 Corinthians 15:19
findings.source_quote: If in this life only we have hope in Christ

findings.source_quote: and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another

findings.translation_quote: Da kan han være stolt av det han selv har gjort, uten å sammenligne seg med andre.
